checks.item: Conflict groups / merged groups are true same photos (sample of about 13 conflict groups viewed)
checks.evidence: Viewed sheets from field_conflicts.csv (tomato early blight overlays, backus-056 potato, apple_black_rot_1 vs apple_scab_66, corn gray leaf spot vs northern blight, potato zoom crops, etc.): all were the same photo under different labels; no false merge seen in the sample

Own search (pHash/dHash over 6 flips/rotations plus a 16x16 gray correlation > 0.9, cross-split, not in residual list) found 23 unlisted pairs; I viewed all of them. 22 are different images (stock isolated leaves, apples, peaches, figures). One is a genuine same photo: datasets/raw/plantdoc/Corn Gray leaf spot/2013Corn_GrayLeafSpot_0815_0003.JPG.jpg (g051780, field_dev, label Cercospora/Gray_leaf_spot) and datasets/raw/plantdoc/Corn leaf blight/2013Corn_GrayLeafSpot_0815_0003.JPG.jpg (g051868, field_train, label Northern_Leaf_Blight). Same filename, same corn leaf with the same lesion, one a 1200x630 crop, the other 1600x1200. Hash distances pHash 16 / dHash 13, so it falls outside both the 8-bit residual list and the 12-bit proposal rule, and the foreground-masked correlation never saw it. Result: a same-photo leak between train and dev, with contradictory labels still in the manifest. This is the same failure type as the earlier potato conflict, and the leaked label conflict is exactly what rule 3 was meant to remove.

failures: Genuine same-photo leak across splits with conflicting labels remains in datasets/manifests/field.csv: rows for 'datasets/raw/plantdoc/Corn Gray leaf spot/2013Corn_GrayLeafSpot_0815_0003.JPG.jpg' (g051780, field_dev, Corn_(maize)___Cercospora_leaf_spot Gray_leaf_spot) and 'datasets/raw/plantdoc/Corn leaf blight/2013Corn_GrayLeafSpot_0815_0003.JPG.jpg' (g051868, field_train, Corn_(maize)___Northern_Leaf_Blight). Same leaf photo at a different crop; hashes pHash 16 / dHash 13 so neither the residual list (<=8) nor the proposal threshold (12) catches it, and the real-manifest test only checks <=8. Reproduce: python orchestration/evidence/tmp-T1.2/c12 view, or open both files. Fix: add to field_reviewed_links.csv (which would send them to conflict removal), and widen the hash search or add a same-basename check so near-duplicates beyond 8 bits are not missed; recheck for other pairs at larger crop differences.

The residual-list completeness test (test_no_unlisted_cross_split_near_duplicate_in_real_manifest) only covers pairs within 8 bits, so it could not detect the leak above; the claim in docs/field-dedup.md that residual coverage is complete is limited to that threshold.
notes: Everything else asked for checks out (lab hash, clean plain pytest, mutation test, conflict sample, potato conflict gone, field_test 1035 images with all 31 classes, no tracked image data). The leaked pair touches train and dev, not field_test, and no genuine same-photo pair touching field_test was found in my searches, but my searches are not exhaustive (the looser threshold search was too noisy to review fully and cv2 was unavailable for feature matching). Only one confirmed leak, but it has contradictory labels, which the earlier failure also flagged. Docs say rules documents 'about 3% false merge'; in my sample of about 13 conflict groups there were no false merges.
